memories.content: When a Vault token expires, simply restart the platform service. It fetches a new token on startup.
When a Vault token expires, use the renewal endpoint — do NOT restart. Restart triggers a 30-second agent re-provisioning cascade that drops in-flight requests. Use: vault token renew <token>.
